name: LayerFS for Herdr
summary: Each Herdr workspace is a LayerFS Branch: a new one in ~0.2 s, restored after restart.

versions.notes: Adds Branch merge (reports real conflicts, ignores each Branch's root .git link), keeps state until drop cleanup succeeds, and resolves the current Branch from cwd outside Herdr.
First listing: docker mode on LayerFS main verified end to end on Debian 13; agents fork from their own pane.
